'''Kodama-hiko no Mikoto''' (児玉彦命) is a {{ill|Kami|en|Kami|qid=Q524158|lt=kami|1=Kami}} worshiped in the {{ill|Suwa Region|lt=Suwa Region|lt=Suwa region|ja|諏訪地方|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suwa Region|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 諏訪地域}} of {{ill|Nagano Prefecture|en|Nagano Prefecture|qid=Q127877|lt=Nagano Prefecture|1=Nagano Prefecture}}, as part of the {{ill|Suwa Faith|ja|諏訪信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suwa Faith|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 諏訪神社|1=Suwa Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q2370082}}.

== Overview ==
[[File:Moriya Family Tree - 守矢氏系図.png|170px|thumbnail|{{Center|The first five generations of the {{ill|Moriya clan|ja|守矢氏|1=Moriya clan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Moriya clan|13=User:Immanuelle/Moriya clan|qq=}} as depicted in the genealogical text}}]]
According to the {{ill|Kaminaga Moriya clan Genealogy|ja|神長守矢氏系譜|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kaminaga Moriya clan Genealogy|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, a genealogy of the {{ill|Moriya clan|ja|守矢氏|1=Moriya clan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Moriya clan|13=User:Immanuelle/Moriya clan|qq=}} compiled in the early {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|qid=Q3125096|lt=Meiji period|1=Meiji era}}:

<blockquote> {{ill|Oogami|ja|大神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Oogami|1=Ōkami|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10937139}}’s child, {{ill|Katakurabe no Mikoto|ja|片倉辺命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Katakurabe no Mikoto|qq=}}, begot Kodama-hiko no Mikoto, who succeeded the position of {{ill|Chikatojin|ja|千鹿頭神|1=Chikatō-no-Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikatojin|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikatō-no-Kami|qq=}} in accordance with the divine words of Oogami. He married Mitutama-hime no Kami, the daughter of Moritatsu no Kami, and they bore Yatsukushin.<ref name="suwa">{{Cite book |title=Kaminaga Moriya clan Genealogy|author=Suwa Educational Association|year=1938|page=34|url=https://dl.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1185913/24}}</ref><ref name="tikatousin">[http://yatsu-genjin.jp/suwataisya/sanpo/tikatousin.htm Chikatojin (Genealogy of Moreya Clan)]</ref>
</blockquote>

As such, Kodama-hiko no Mikoto is regarded as the fourth generation in the genealogy of the Moriya clan.<ref name="tikatousin"/><ref>『続・高部の文化財』高部歴史編纂委員会編、2006th year 、31頁</ref>

== Genealogy ==
Kodama-hiko no Mikoto is the child of {{ill|Katakurabe no Mikoto|ja|片倉辺命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Katakurabe no Mikoto|qq=}}, though his mother is unknown. His spouse, Mitutama-hime no Kami, the daughter of Moritatsu no Kami, bore him Yatsukushin, who is regarded as the fifth generation in the Moriya clan’s genealogy.<ref name="suwa"/>

== Shrines ==
Kodama-hiko no Mikoto is enshrined in the following locations:
* {{ill|Kodama-ishi Shrine|ja|児玉石神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kodama-ishi Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (Yuno-waki, {{ill|Suwa, Nagano|en|Suwa, Nagano|qid=Q846338|lt=Suwa City|1=Suwa, Nagano}}, Nagano Prefecture)
* {{ill|Taisan Shrine|ja|泰山神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Taisan Shrine|qq=}} ({{ill|Takamori Town|ja|高森町|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takamori Town|1=Takamorimachi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q31469}}, {{ill|Shimoina District, Nagano|en|Shimoina District, Nagano|qid=Q726999|lt=Shimoina District|1=Shimoina District, Nagano}}, Nagano Prefecture)

'''Kodama-hiko no Mikoto''' (児玉彦命) is a deity of {{ill|Suwa Faith|ja|諏訪信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suwa Faith|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 諏訪神社|1=Suwa Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q2370082}}, a traditional belief system rooted in the {{ill|Suwa Region|lt=Suwa Region|lt=Suwa region|ja|諏訪地方|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Suwa region|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 諏訪地域}} of {{ill|Nagano Prefecture|en|Nagano Prefecture|qid=Q127877|lt=Nagano Prefecture|1=Nagano Prefecture}}.

== Overview ==
[[File:Moriya Family Tree - 守矢氏系図.png|170px|thumbnail|center|The first five generations of the {{ill|Moriya clan|ja|守矢氏|1=Moriya clan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Moriya clan|13=User:Immanuelle/Moriya clan|qq=}} lineage according to the ''Genealogy of the Moriya clan'' (洩矢神から八櫛神まで).]]
According to the genealogy of the {{ill|Moriya clan|ja|守矢氏|1=Moriya clan|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Moriya clan|13=User:Immanuelle/Moriya clan|qq=}}, compiled during the early {{ill|Meiji era|en|Meiji era|qid=Q3125096|lt=Meiji period|1=Meiji era}}, Kodama-hiko no Mikoto is described as follows:
<blockquote>
"The son of Katakurabe no Mikoto, a child of the Great Deity ({{ill|Takeminakata|en|Takeminakata|qid=Q9150391|qid=Q9150391|lt=Takeminakata|1=Takeminakata}}). Following the command of the Great Deity, he succeeded {{ill|Chikato|ja|千鹿頭神|1=Chikatō-no-Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikato|13=User:Immanuelle/Chikatō-no-Kami|qq=}} as the overseer of rituals and governance. He married Mitsutama-hime, daughter of {{ill|Moritachi no Kami|ja|守達神|1=Moritachi no Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Moritachi no Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Moritachi no Kami|qq=}}, and they bore Yasugami."<ref name="suwa">{{Cite web|title=Genealogy of the Moriya clan|url=https://dl.ndl.go.jp/info:ndljp/pid/1185913/24|publisher=Suwa Historical Association|year=1938|access-date=2023-12-04}}</ref><ref name="tikatousin">{{Cite web|title=Chikato and the Moriya Lineage|url=http://yatsu-genjin.jp/suwataisya/sanpo/tikatousin.htm|publisher=Yatsu Genjin|access-date=2023-12-04}}</ref>
</blockquote>

This makes Kodama-hiko no Mikoto the fourth generation of the Moriya lineage.<ref name="tikatousin"/><ref>''Continued Cultural Assets of Takabe,'' Takabe History Compilation Committee, 2006, p. 31.</ref>

== Lineage ==
Kodama-hiko no Mikoto is the child of {{ill|Katakurabe no Mikoto|ja|片倉辺命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Katakurabe no Mikoto|qq=}}, with his mother unknown. He married {{ill|Mitsutama-hime no Kami|ja|美都多麻比売神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mitsutama-hime no Kami|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, the daughter of {{ill|Moritachi no Kami|ja|守達神|1=Moritachi no Kami|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Moritachi no Kami|13=User:Immanuelle/Moritachi no Kami|qq=}}, and they had Yasugami, who is regarded as the fifth generation of the Moriya clan.<ref name="suwa"/>

== Shrines ==
Kodama-hiko no Mikoto is enshrined at the following locations:
* {{ill|Kodama-ishi Shrine|ja|児玉石神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kodama-ishi Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (Yunowaki, Suwa City, Nagano Prefecture)
* {{ill|Taisan Shrine|lt=Taisan Shrine|lt=Taizan Shrine (Takamori)|ja|泰山神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Taizan Shrine (Takamori)|qq=}} (Takamori Town, {{ill|Shimoina District, Nagano|en|Shimoina District, Nagano|qid=Q726999|lt=Shimoina District, Nagano|1=Shimoina District, Nagano}}, Nagano Prefecture)
